summary: This note is a short biography of Richard Michael Wallace, a former rugby union winger who played for Garryowen, Munster, Saracens, Ireland and the Lions. It notes his 29 caps for Ireland, his membership of Munster's first Heineken Cup squad, his 1991 debut against Namibia, and his record as Ireland's all-time top try scorer in Rugby World Cup Sevens with 10 tries.
one_line: Irish former rugby union winger who played for Munster, Saracens, Ireland and the Lions and set a Rugby World Cup Sevens try record.
key_facts: Richard Michael Wallace was born on 16 January 1968.
Richard Wallace is a former rugby union player for Garryowen, Munster, Saracens, Ireland and the Lions.
Richard Wallace played as a winger.
Richard Wallace gained 29 caps with the Ireland national rugby union team.
Richard Wallace was a member of the first Munster team to compete in the Heineken Cup.
Richard Wallace made his full international debut in 1991 against Namibia.
Richard Wallace is the all-time top try scorer for the Ireland national rugby sevens team in Rugby World Cup Sevens.
Richard Wallace scored 10 tries in Rugby World Cup Sevens for Ireland.
